qualitative.evidence: Fortinet has demonstrated elite compounding over 15+ public operating years, scaling revenue from $1.28B (2016) to $6.80B (2025) with operating margins expanding to 30.7%. Proprietary custom ASIC silicon provides enduring price/performance moat and 55% global firewall unit share. Structural negative working capital and upfront deferred revenue billings yield multi-year Owner FCF conversion of 115-132% ($2.16B FCF vs $1.85B NI in FY2025). Founder Ken Xie holds substantial insider equity (~16%); fortress balance sheet holds $2.50B cash against $497M debt ($2.0B net cash, interest coverage >100x).
